summary: 4-component vector normalizer with a squared-length threshold. Computes the squared length of input a2 over its X, Y and Z components. When the squared length reaches the global threshold dword_8D600C, computes a Newton-Raphson refined reciprocal-sqrt of the squared length (using dword_8D6010 and dword_8D6014) and writes all four scaled components (including W) into output a1. When the squared length falls below the threshold, zeroes all four output components. Returns the output pointer a1.

local_names.v5: squared length of the input (sum of component squares over X, Y, Z)
local_names.v6: reciprocal sqrt of the squared length
local_names.v7: final per-component scale factor from the Newton-Raphson refinement

operations.description: Compute squared length v5 = a2[0]*a2[0] + a2[1]*a2[1] + a2[2]*a2[2].
Threshold guard: if dword_8D600C <= v5, normalize; otherwise fall through to the zeroing branch. The threshold is read from the global at 0x008D600C.
v6 = 1.0 / fsqrt(v5), then Newton-Raphson refinement: v7 = dword_8D6010 * v6 * (dword_8D6014 - v5 * v6 * v6), reading refinement constants at 0x008D6010 and 0x008D6014.
Write normalized components to the output: a1[0] = v7 * a2[0], a1[1] = v7 * a2[1], a1[2] = v7 * a2[2], a1[3] = v7 * a2[3] (W also scaled).
Threshold-miss branch: zero all four output components a1[0..3].

clean_pseudocode: float scale = dword_8D6010 * inv * (dword_8D6014 - lenSq * inv * inv);
out[0] = scale * in[0]; out[1] = scale * in[1];
out[2] = scale * in[2]; out[3] = scale * in[3];
